techniques.name: Phishing: Spearphishing Link
techniques.procedure: 228 active phishing URLs identified via OpenPhish targeting gaming platforms (Roblox, Fortnite), social media (Meta/Instagram/Facebook), crypto wallets (Ledger, Trezor, MetaMask), e-commerce (Amazon, Shopee, eBay), and streaming services (Netflix).

techniques.name: Link Target
techniques.procedure: Phishing infrastructure hosted on legitimate platforms: Vercel (25), Blogspot (18), IPFS (10), Netlify (8), Wasmer (6), GitBook (6), Weebly (4), EdgeOne (4), GitHub Pages (4) — used to evade domain reputation blocklists.

techniques.name: Domains
techniques.procedure: Typosquatting domains impersonating Ledger (ledger-shop-now[.]com, ledger-entry[.]com, ledgervaultshop[.]com), T-Mobile (t-mobile[.]fvypec[.]top), and DPD parcel delivery (dpd[.]czplqw[.]ink, dpd[.]shipdora[.]top).

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
techniques.procedure: 4 active Emotet C2 IP addresses communicating over HTTP/HTTPS, identified via Feodo Tracker.
